gate_policy.unlock_rule: MASTER creates data/experiments/experiment_005a/empirical_gate.json after full 004C freeze and preflight --empirical passes

role_policy.ambiguity: never coerced; attribution and fee-enablement conflicts fail closed
role_policy.multiple_fee_records: prevents high-confidence upgrade; retained for audit
role_policy.paired_fill_upgrade: not implemented until exact match segmentation is validated; transaction grouping alone is insufficient

signed_flow.provenance: participant_address is the signed order owner; upstream side parser is owner-relative and custody-validated
signed_flow.supportive_confidence: reported separately; never pooled silently with primary

own_market_flow_response.primary_question: incremental subsequent markout after controlling already-observed source price movement

family_cross_market_flow_response.primary_comparison: B_future ~ B_history + common_event + A_price_move versus same + A_signed_aggressive_flow
family_cross_market_flow_response.pair_selection: frozen verified economic-family metadata only; never observed 005A performance

participant_role_structure.encoding: TRAIN-only or leave-future-out cross-fitted with shrinkage and unknown-wallet fallback

maker_adverse_selection.response: post-fill markout from passive maker economic perspective

liquidity_renewal_response.genuine_change: deduplicate unchanged BBO states; actual bid/ask change only

nulls.market_time_block_flow_shift: within market/event/regime preserving bursts, size, role composition and missingness
nulls.sign_null: preserve timestamps, unsigned volume, market, regime and activity only where mechanical side constraints permit
nulls.participant_role_null: preserve market/time/role/activity while breaking participant identity

multiplicity.method: Benjamini-Hochberg/FDR within declared family where valid

independence.inference: cluster/block/event aware; raw rows reported separately from effective evidence

infrastructure.participant_rule: exclude confirmed infra/exchange/system entities from trader-behaviour analysis or model explicitly as nuisance/system entities

exposure_ledger.holdout_claim: none of the historical election families is globally pristine; future 005B evidence must account for exposure

primary_promotion_interpretation.cross_market: role-aware A flow must add information beyond A's actual price move; otherwise it is not a new mechanism
primary_promotion_interpretation.participant: identity must add information specifically in taker role using strictly cross-fitted history
primary_promotion_interpretation.maker: adverse-selection state must survive realistic null/FDR/stability checks
